LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_SaveLoadTraceTip: Log major startup and save/load stages to Player.log with low overhead.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_SaveLoadFullTraceTip: Also log nested DeepProfiler stages to Player.log. Enable this only while diagnosing a loading problem.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_AdaptivePathHeuristicTip: Scale the A* heuristic to the actual integer movement cost. This fixes long detours for very fast pawns.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_WorldPathCorrectnessTip: Use the actual clamped caravan movement cost and an exact shortest-path search on the planet map. This favors correctness over path-search speed.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_SparseDynamicPathDataTip: Clear only cells written by the previous door, provider, or pawn-blocking pass.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_WorkScanThrottleTip: On large maps, delay repeated no-result JobGiver_Work scans while preserving other think-tree branches.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_WorkPriorityCacheTip: Warm each pawn's ordered work-giver lists when the work tab closes and reuse them until invalidated or refreshed.
LanguageData.OhYouAreSoFast_MinimumMapSize: Minimum map size for work scan: {0} cells
